stories.title: Socceroos’ future looks bright as Australia stun Argentina in U17 World Cup
summary: Akol Akon sealed a 2-0 win over football powerhouse in QatarJoeys mark return to tournament for first time in seven yearsSydney FC prodigy Akol Akon has demonstrated why he’s one of the most exciting talents in Australian football, leading the Joeys to a shock 2-0 victory over Argentina to launch their U17 World Cup campaign in style.The brilliant young winger had his shot deflected for an own goal on the hour and then produced an audaciously cheeky finish 11 minutes later to seal the opening-day win on Friday (AEDT) as Carl Veart’s side announced their return to the global boys’ competition for the first time in seven years.

stories.title: Alexander Zverev beats Arthur Fils in ATP Finals tennis group stage – as it happened
summary: The world No 1 made it three straight-sets wins out of three to finish top of his group ahead of Ben Shelton, who also qualifies for the semi-finalsFirst set: Zverev* 0-1 Fils (*denotes next server)Fils starts as he means to go on with a short opening point.
A longer rally plays out on the third, before Zverev eventually flings a forehand long.

Fils concedes his first point with a mis-hit forehand – his forehand is the fastest and heaviest on tour, but that one won’t make the match highlights reel – though the cross-court forehand winner that seals the game will do.

stories.title: Fifa sparks tension with demand for tax-free status in UK for Women’s World Cup
summary: It also wants exchange-rate fees exemption for 2035Fifa at loggerheads with UK’s four FAs and governmentFifa is at loggerheads with the UK’s government and four football associations over the world governing body’s demands for tax-free status and exemptions from exchange-rate fees at the 2035 Women’s World Cup.The UK bid to host the tournament is due to be ratified at an extraordinary Fifa congress in Zurich on Monday and the Guardian has learned there is tension behind the scenes over many of Fifa’s requirements, which multiple sources involved in the discussions have indicated will not be met.
